    Left almost-split monomorphisms for finite-dimensional modules #

    Finite-dimensional contragredient duality transfers finite projective presentations to finite injective copresentations. Consequently the chosen left almost-split map at a noninjective indecomposable is monic. Its cokernel projection is then the dual Auslander--Reiten map.
